description: This Java class CheckExternalFilter extends AbstractHeaderEntryFilter and is used to determine whether headers should be read from or written to external headers based on header definitions and predicates. It provides factory methods for creating filters with different conditions related to external header permissions.

classes.name: CheckExternalFilter
classes.description: Final class extending AbstractHeaderEntryFilter, used to filter headers based on external read/write permissions.

methods.name: shouldReadFromExternal
methods.description: Creates a filter to check if headers can be read from external sources based on header definitions.

methods.name: shouldWriteToExternal
methods.description: Creates a filter to check if headers can be written to external sources based on header definitions.

methods.name: existsAsHeaderDefinition
methods.description: Creates a filter to check if a header definition exists for the given headers.
